errors.passwordMin: Password must be at least 10 characters.
errors.termsRequired: You must accept the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Log in to manage your shop.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start with your account, then set up your shop.
signup.acceptTerms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
signup.checkEmailBody: If this email address can be registered, we have sent a verification link to it. The link is valid for 24 hours.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a reset link if an account exists.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for this email, a password reset link is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Use at least 10 characters. You will be logged out of all other devices.
reset.doneBody: Your password has been changed. Log in with your new password.

verify.successBody: Thanks. Your account is active. Next, set up your shop.
verify.expiredTitle: This link is no longer valid
verify.expiredBody: The verification link has expired or has already been used. Sign up again to receive a new link.
